summary: Frontend MENU editor (FunnelStepForm sub-editor, sibling-step target picker via SearchableSelect, MENU summary, inline funnel_broken_edge) follows the existing per-type form idiom and graph-model decisions. Client validation mirrors backend validateSteps. One minor label-numbering issue fixed in review.

findings.finding: menuTargetOptions used the FILTERED array index for the displayed step-position number, so the '{n}.' prefix could diverge from the funnel-steps-list numbering when un-targetable steps (no id / the edited MENU itself) precede a target.
findings.resolution: Capture the real position from the full siblingSteps array before filtering, so the label number matches FunnelStepsList.

findings.finding: MENU button rows are a local reactive array validated by hand on submit (not vee-validate fields). This is consistent with the task's explicit guidance and the form's existing per-widget pattern; manual gate in onSubmit blocks emit when invalid.
findings.resolution: No change — intentional design, covered by tests.

findings.finding: Emitted Button shape {type,label,targetStepId,url} matches frontend Button interface and backend ButtonDto byte-for-byte; End encoded as targetStepId:null (verified against FunnelService.validateMenu / requireExistingTarget).
